subject: Literature
title: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie and the Single Story
description: A quick win: understand Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie and the Single Story.

hook.text: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie's TED Talk 'The Danger of a Single Story' has been viewed over thirty million times worldwide.

buildup.text: Her novels Americanah and Half of a Yellow Sun explore Nigerian identity, immigration, and the legacy of colonialism.

discovery.text: Adichie argues that reducing any people to a single narrative is a form of power that flattens complex human experience.

twist.text: Her essay 'We Should All Be Feminists' was sampled by Beyoncé, bringing literary feminism to a global pop audience.

climax.text: Adichie bridges literary fiction and popular culture, proving that serious ideas can reach audiences beyond the bookshelf.

punchline.text: A Nigerian novelist's feminism reached millions through Beyoncé.

quiz.question: How did Adichie's feminist essay reach a global pop audience?
options: It was adapted into a Hollywood film
Beyoncé sampled it in a song
It was taught in every American school
